title: Has anyone got real results from an 'AI search' agency?

comments.text: We paid Acme Digital £20k over six months to 'get us into ChatGPT'. Zero measurable change. They couldn't even tell us how they were measuring it.
Honest answer: nobody knows how to measure this yet, which is exactly why every agency is selling it.
The only thing that moved the needle for us was getting listed on the comparison sites the models actually cite. Not glamorous.
I run a 35 person consultancy in Leeds and we started getting inbound where the prospect literally said ChatGPT suggested us. It's real, we just can't tell what caused it.
Careful, half these agencies are the same people who sold 'voice search optimisation' in 2018.
